scope: Ubuntu 22.04 + ROS 2 Humble + Gazebo Classic 11 recheck of the bounded visible-escape change. Nav2 and the fixed-mode simple demo do not use PathTracker and were unchanged since 40f2434.

multi_goal_sequence.note: The reset at (1.7,3.0) left the mapped footprint close to furniture. The bounded escape produced 3 samples (about 0.3 s), then normal tracking resumed and the goal was reached.

conclusion.home_map: At 40f2434, v1 and v2 were close on the standalone home-map goals (about 23 s to (0,0), 38-39 s from spawn to (2,3)). This recheck confirms the bounded escape does not regress multi-goal/reset or mid-motion goal changes; it is not a new v1/v2 comparison.
conclusion.v2_advantage: Not proven in Gazebo. The 95/96 result is a Windows 2D holdout; these Linux runs are not a success-rate estimate.
conclusion.escape_change: The bounded escape resolves the mapped-overlap deadlock after reset and returns to normal visibility quickly. No intervention was recorded.
